title: Decision: the hub lets through a GroupContextExtensions proposal that only sets the did_webvh record (narrows mimid-1wgh.6.2)
description:
draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-01 §Expected Heads: "A Commit that changes the expected value MUST therefore include a GroupContextExtensions proposal that sets it." Every Commit that adds a new did_webvh user, or carries a newer log (revocation, a new device), changes the record. mimid's hub refuses every GroupContextExtensions proposal (decision mimid-1wgh.6.2, hub/policy.rs), so as it stands no such Commit could pass a mimid hub.

Readings: (a) keep refusing GroupContextExtensions; did_webvh rooms cannot add users or revoke devices. (b) allow any GroupContextExtensions in rooms with did_webvh members. (c) allow exactly the GroupContextExtensions proposal the rules require: one whose extensions differ from the current GroupContext only in did_webvh_heads and in required_capabilities gaining did_webvh_heads and did_webvh (what mimi-mls's with_heads writes; decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.16), checked while the Observer enforces the rules, which also checks the record equals the expected one.

Chosen: (c). mimi-mls's Observer reports such a proposal as ProposalKind::DidWebvhRecord (only after Observer::enforce_did_webvh), and the hub's policy needs no capability for it: the change is mechanical and fully determined by the tree (draft §Rules; decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.17). Every other GroupContextExtensions proposal is still refused. Narrows mimid-1wgh.6.2 for this one shape.
notes: 2026-11-18, superseded by bead mimid-1wgh.4.81.34 (Mark: the record is an app_data_dictionary component, the only form): no Commit needs a GroupContextExtensions proposal for the record, so the exception is removed. ProposalKind::DidWebvhRecord (mimi-mls observer and hub policy) and didwebvh::is_record_change are deleted, and decision mimid-1wgh.6.2 (refuse every GroupContextExtensions proposal) holds again without a carve-out; test hub_didwebvh::every_group_context_extensions_proposal_is_refused.
close_reason: Chosen by agent; 114b25c ProposalKind::DidWebvhRecord, 088d81f hub policy; hub_didwebvh.rs tests both sides; feedback items 23-24; flag to Mark
